ns2:section.sectionText: Course introduces students to community development practices and the participatory action research approach as related to social justice issues. Detailed information about the course is available at http://eslarp.illinois.edu/. Enrollment in this class requires attendance in two in-class sessions (October 3 and October 10 from 3:30 to 4:50 pm) and one outreach experience on October 5 and 6. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 3 hours.
